book.name: 2 Tesalonaika
book.title: Tesalonaika Lenji Leta Theghewoniye Pol Le Rorori

content: Ghino Pol weiŋguyaŋgi Sailas na Timoti wo roriya letake iyake na wo variye i ghaona e ghemi ekelesiya Tesalonaika, ghemi hu yaku weya Loi Ramanda na Giya Jisas Krais.
Wo naŋgo weya Loi Ramanda na Giya Jisas Krais thɨ mwaewo e ghemi na lenji gharemalɨlɨ i riyevanjara gharemina.
Loi le ghathaghatha i thovuye moli

Lama bodaboda, mbaŋake wolaghɨye mbala wo vata ago weya Loi kaiwami. Valɨkaiwame moli wo vakatha ŋgoreiye, kaiwae lemi loŋweghathɨna i mbuthu na mbe i laghɨlaghɨye vara na i vurɨgheghe moli, na ghemi regha na regha lemi gharethovu weŋgiya ghamune mbe i laghɨlaghɨye vara.
Iya kaiwae wo wovorevoreŋaŋga weŋgiya Loi le ekelesiya. Wo utuŋa weŋgi kaiwae othembe thɨ vakatha vuyowo weŋga, hu ghataŋaghathɨ na lemi loŋweghathɨna i vurɨgheghe.

Bigibigike thiyake thɨ woraŋgiya weinda mbaŋa Loi ne i ghathaŋgiya gharɨgharɨ ne i mboromboro. Ghemi Loi ne i wovarumwarumwaruŋaŋga na ne iŋa na hu ru ele ghamba mbaro tɨne, iya hu ghataŋa vɨrɨ kaiwae.
Loi iye raghathaghatha thovuye na i vakatha i rumwaru: thavala thɨ vakavakatha vuyowo e ghemi amalaghɨniye tene i lithɨ weŋgi,
na ghemi iya hu vaidiya vuyowona ne i vatowoŋaŋga, na ghime tembe ŋgoreiyeva. Ne i vakatha ŋgoreiyako, mbaŋa Giya Jisas ne i yomara e buruburuko weiyaŋgiya le nyao thovuthovuye vurɨvurɨgheghe.
Ne i mena weiye ndɨghe i rara, na thavala ma thɨ ghareghare Loi na ma thɨ wovatha ghanda Giya Jisas Totoniye Thovuye ne i lithɨ weŋgi.
Lenji goriwoyathuko modae ne thɨ vaidiya mukuwo memeghabananiye. Ne thɨ meghaghathɨ Giya e ghamwae na le vwenyevwenye vurɨvurɨghegheniye manjamanjalawae e tɨne.

Bigibigike thiyake ne thɨ yomara mbaŋaniye Giya ne i njoghama, na le gharɨgharɨ boboma, thiye gharaloŋweloŋweghathɨke wolaghɨye, ne thɨ wovavwenyevwenyeŋa na thɨ yavwatatawana. Ghemi tembe inamiva e wabwiko iyako tɨne, kaiwae kaero hu loŋweghathɨgha Toto Thovuye va wo utuŋa e ghemi.

Iyake kaiwae mbaŋake wolaghɨye wo naŋgonaŋgo kaiwami. Wo naŋgo weya Loi na mbala i thalavuŋga na valɨkaiwae yawalɨko iyava kaiwae na i kulako e ghemi, na mbala mbe hu loŋgaloŋgawe vara. Wo naŋgowe na mbala le vurɨgheghe e tɨne i thalavuŋga, na mbala thovuyeko iya nuwamiya hu vakathako na kaiwoko thovuye iya i mena e lemi loŋweghathɨna mbe hu vakavakatha vara.
Wo naŋgo ŋgoreiyako na mbala e ghemi gharɨgharɨ thɨ wovavwenyevwenye ghanda Giya Jisas, na iye i vavwenyevwenyeŋga. Iyake i mena weya la Loi na ghanda Giya Jisas Krais lenji mwaewo e tɨne.
